title: Compliance and Approvals persona pages — minimal MVPs on top of what Phases A-D built
context: Phases A-D built the substrate (audit_event, permissions, scope, activation, four-eye) but only surfaced Admin. Track 1 originally called for two more persona pages: Compliance (read the audit trail + policy history + AI activity log) and Approvals (signer's queue + delegation + bulk). Both are here as minimum-viable versions.
compliance_scope_in: GET /compliance/activity — filterable audit_event feed (actor, action, subject_type, date range, limit)
GET /compliance/activity.csv — CSV export peer, streams from the same query
/compliance page with a filter bar + activity table + CSV download button
Guarded by VIEW_AUDIT (COMPLIANCE_OFFICER, CFO, AUDITOR) or MANAGE_USERS (ADMIN)
compliance_scope_out_deferred: Policy version history + diff — needs richer policy_version reads first
Override register as a dedicated tab — already visible via action filter
AI activity log — needs an ai_run table (not built yet, Q-004 open)
As-of-date replay — needs point-in-time query support across services
approvals_scope_in: GET /approvals/queue — deals with status=PROPOSED, joined to counterparty; each row carries can_approve (role match + not proposer)
/approvals page — table + one-click Approve for eligible rows, 'Not eligible' label otherwise
Reuses existing POST /deals/{id}/approve — server-side segregation-of-duties still enforced
approvals_scope_out_deferred: Delegation flow (out-of-office reassignment) — needs delegation table
Bulk approvals — batch endpoint + multi-select UI
History tab (my past decisions) — reads existing check_run + deal audit already
invariants: Compliance is READ-ONLY. Every endpoint under /compliance is a GET; no writes.
Approvals still runs the six-check gate on approve — the persona page is a surface, not a bypass.
SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES enforcement is server-side; the queue's can_approve hint is UI only.
consequences: frontend/app/compliance/page.tsx — filter bar + table + CSV export
frontend/app/approvals/page.tsx — queue table + one-click Approve for eligible rows
